mapper.select: SELECT likes.id , likes.deleted , likes.created_at as createdAt , likes.modified_at as modifiedAt , likes.post_id as postId , likes.user_id as userId FROM `like` likes WHERE likes.id = #{id}

SELECT likes.id , likes.deleted , likes.created_at as createdAt , likes.modified_at as modifiedAt , likes.post_id as postId , likes.user_id as userId FROM `like` likes WHERE likes.post_id = #{postId} AND likes.deleted = false ORDER BY likes.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `like` likes WHERE likes.post_id = #{postId} AND likes.deleted = false
SELECT count(likes.id) as listsize FROM `like` likes

SELECT likes.id FROM `like` likes
ORDER BY likes.id DESC ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{perpage}
